messages:
Chloë Li: Hey team — need to lock in a facilitator and attendee list for the postmortem on incident RWINF-2026-11 (late-night latency spike + graceful fallback). Prefer schedule before EOW if possible. Who can facilitate?

Alex D.: I can facilitate, but only Mon/Tue mornings PST. I prefer a short, focused 60min runbook + action-item capture.

Maria S.: I can co-facilitate as backup. Available Wed/Fri afternoons UTC. Happy to take notes if Alex leads.

Jamal R.: Oncall will need to be there — I'll RSVP. My availability is flexible except Thu morning UTC. Also we should invite infra and product: @Priya for product context, and infra rotation (if someone can ping infra on this thread).

Priya N.: I can join Mon/Tue afternoon PST or Wed morning UTC. Product will want the customer-impact timeline and rollback rationale. Can you attach the incident timeline doc?

Chloë Li: Adding the timeline now: <https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/RWINF-2026-11/timeline> — please skim before the meeting. Proposed facilitator slot options (pick one or suggest):
```
Option A: Mon 09:00-10:00 PST (Mon 17:00-18:00 UTC)
Option B: Tue 10:00-11:00 PST (Tue 18:00-19:00 UTC)
Option C: Wed 08:00-09:00 PST (Wed 16:00-17:00 UTC)
```

Alex D.: Option A works for me.

Maria S.: Option A conflicts for me. Option B would work.

Jamal R.: Option A is ok for oncall — I can make A or B.

Priya N.: Option A ok for product.

Chloë Li: Looks like Option A has majority (Alex, Jamal, Priya). Maria can be backup. I'll tentatively book Option A and assign facilitator to Alex D. If Alex can't, Maria will step in.

Chloë Li: Quick logistical checklist before meeting:
- Facilitator: Alex D. (confirmed)
- Time: Mon 09:00-10:00 PST (booked) — calendar invite: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event?eid=RWINF-2026-11-pm>
- Required attendees: oncall rotation, infra rep, product (Priya), eng owner, SRE lead
- Optional: support, security if we think data path involved
- Pre-read: timeline + logs link (above), stacktrace snippets in doc

Alex D.: I'll drive the agenda:
1) 10m quick incident summary & customer impact
2) 25m timeline + RCA discussion (owners speak to their parts)
3) 15m action items + owners + deadlines
4) 10m wrap + follow-ups

Maria S.: I'll capture action items in the postmortem doc and create corresponding GH issues where relevant.

Jamal R.: Oncall will provide logs and the temporary mitigation steps we ran (shifting traffic, fallback configs). I'll post the command snippets in the doc so infra can review.

Chloë Li: Folks, please add any must-invite names to the thread now. Also if anyone needs a different timezone for accessibility, flag it — we can record.

Priya N.: Please invite support lead "Nate W." and "infra-ops". They need to hear customer impact directly.

Alex D.: Noted — adding Nate W. and infra-ops. Also pinging @incident-bot to create the postmortem template and reminder 1 hour before.

incident-bot: Created postmortem draft at <https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/RWINF-2026-11/postmortem-draft>. Reminder scheduled for Mon 08:00 PST.

Chloë Li: Thanks — final ask: if you cannot attend, please reply with delegate name. We need someone from infra to be live for 1) KV cache checks and 2) kernel selection logs.

Maria S.: If I can't make it, I will delegate to "Sanjay P." who knows the runtime kernel piece.

Alex D.: If anything changes on my side I will update the calendar and assign Maria as facilitator.

Jamal R.: I'll paste mitigation commands here after lunch so infra has them prepped.

Chloë Li: Great. I'll mark action items in the draft: facilitator=ALEX D.; recorder=Maria S. (backup), meeting_time=1745679600 (Mon 09:00 PST), attendees=[Alex D., Maria S., Jamal R., Priya N., Nate W., infra-ops]; pre-reads linked. See you Monday. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
